name: Ohio

agency.name: Ohio Department of Commerce, Division of Industrial Compliance, Bureau of Wage and Hour Administration

rates2026.area: Employers with annual gross receipts above $405,000
rates2026.note: Indexed each January 1 to CPI-W (Ohio Constitution Art. II, Sec. 34a)

rates2026.area: Employers with annual gross receipts of $405,000 or less, and 14-15-year-old workers
rates2026.note: Tied to the federal minimum wage

minWage.headlineArea: Employers with annual gross receipts above $405,000

rates2027.area: Employers with annual gross receipts above $419,000
rates2027.note: officially announced on 2026-09-30 by the Ohio Department of Commerce (+3.5%)

rates2027.area: Employers with annual gross receipts of $419,000 or less, and 14-15-year-old workers

minWage.smallEmployer: Businesses with annual gross receipts of $405,000 or less (2026; $419,000 from 2027-01-01) and 14-15-year-olds: $7.25 (federal rate).

tipped.note: 2026 tipped rate for covered employers; rises to $5.70 on 2027-01-01. Tipped employee = more than $30/month in tips (dol.gov table).

source.quote: $11.40 per hour for non-tipped employees and $5.70 per hour for tipped employees, represents a 3.5% increase from the current 2026 rates of $11 for non-tipped employees and $5.50 for tipped employees

overtime.note: Ohio overtime follows FLSA sections 7 and 13 (same exemptions).

source.quote: an employer shall pay an employee for overtime at a wage rate of one and one-half times the employee's wage rate for hours worked in excess of forty hours in one workweek

sickLeave.note: No statewide paid sick leave law for private employers.

finalPay.fired: no special final-pay rule: wages are due on the regular semi-monthly schedule (by the 1st of the month for wages earned through the 15th of the prior month, and by the 15th for the rest of the prior month)
finalPay.quit: same as fired: regular semi-monthly schedule
finalPay.ptoNote: No statute requires payout; vacation pay is a fringe benefit owed only under the employer's agreement/policy.

source.quote: on or before the first day of each month, pay all its employees the wages earned by them during the first half of the preceding month ending with the fifteenth day thereof

ptoSource.quote: "Fringe benefits" includes but is not limited to health, welfare, or retirement benefits ... or vacation, separation, or holiday pay.

breaks.minorsOnly: Minors (under 18): a rest period of at least 30 minutes after more than 5 consecutive hours.

source.quote: No employer shall employ a minor more than five consecutive hours without allowing the minor a rest period of at least thirty minutes.

notes.text: Ohio's minimum wage rises to $11.40 (tipped $5.70) on January 1, 2027, and the gross-receipts threshold for coverage rises from $405,000 to $419,000.

source.quote: Effective Jan. 1, 2027, the Ohio minimum wage will apply to businesses with annual gross receipts of more than $419,000, which is an increase from the current $405,000 threshold.

notes.text: Ohio's minimum wage is written into the state constitution (amendment approved by voters in November 2006) and is indexed every January 1 to the CPI-W for the 12 months ending in August.

source.quote: The change reflects the mandate of the Constitutional Amendment (II-34a), passed by Ohio voters in November 2006
